label: Illustrative common VR comparison

dimensions.label: Temporal stability
dimensions.description: Prefer the stimulus with less shimmer, flicker, ghosting, or unstable detail during motion.
dimensions.notes: Judge repeated motion and disocclusion rather than one still frame.

dimensions.label: Overall preference
dimensions.description: Select the stimulus preferred overall after recording technical dimensions independently.
dimensions.notes: This explicitly subjective dimension must not replace correctness judgments.

magnitudes.label: Imperceptible
magnitudes.description: No repeatable visible difference is established.

magnitudes.label: Slight
magnitudes.description: A repeatable difference is visible under inspection.

magnitudes.label: Moderate
magnitudes.description: The difference is readily visible during ordinary comparison.

magnitudes.label: Large
magnitudes.description: The difference materially changes the viewed result.

magnitudes.label: Severe
magnitudes.description: The difference includes dominant degradation or failure.

notes: Illustrative structure only; publish task-specific rubrics as evidence.
